ev.q: NewsRadio is an American television sitcom
It had an ensemble cast featuring Dave Foley, Stephen Root, Andy Dick
combined physical humor and visual gags
with quick-witted dialogue and farcical storylines
took the surrealism to the extreme
Plots often involved satirical takes on historical events
aired on NBC from March 21, 1995, to May 4, 1999
There are a total of 97 episodes
